verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כִּ֥י אִ֕ישׁ יַפְלִ֖א נֶ֑דֶר לַֽיהוָֽה׃ בְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ נְפָשֹׁ֖ת
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kî ’îš yap̄·li ne·ḏer Yah·weh bə·‘er·kə·ḵā nə·p̄ā·šōṯ
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and say to them When someone makes a special vow to the LORD involving the value of persons

verses.original: עֶרְכְּךָ֙ וְהָיָ֤ה הַזָּכָ֔ר מִבֶּן֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־ שִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה עֶרְכְּךָ֗ וְהָיָ֣ה חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים שֶׁ֥קֶל כֶּ֖סֶף הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃ בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל
verses.transliteration: ‘er·kə·ḵā wə·hā·yāh haz·zā·ḵār mib·ben ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh wə·‘aḏ ben- šiš·šîm šā·nāh ‘er·kə·ḵā wə·hā·yāh ḥă·miš·šîm še·qel ke·sep̄ haq·qō·ḏeš bə·še·qel
verses.literal: if the valuation concerns a male . . . from twenty - to . . . sixty years of age then your valuation shall be fifty shekels of silver according to the sanctuary shekel

verses.original: וְאִם־ הִ֑וא נְקֵבָ֖ה עֶרְכְּךָ֖ וְהָיָ֥ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָֽׁקֶל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- hî nə·qê·ḇāh ‘er·kə·ḵā wə·hā·yāh šə·lō·šîm šā·qel
verses.literal: Or if it is a female then your valuation shall be thirty shekels

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם חָמֵ֜שׁ וְעַד֙ בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה מִבֶּן־ שָׁנִ֗ים עֶרְכְּךָ֛ הַזָּכָ֖ר וְהָיָ֧ה עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֑ים וְלַנְּקֵבָ֖ה עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת שְׁקָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im ḥā·mêš wə·‘aḏ ben- ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh mib·ben- šā·nîm ‘er·kə·ḵā haz·zā·ḵār wə·hā·yāh ‘eś·rîm šə·qā·lîm wə·lan·nə·qê·ḇāh ‘ă·śe·reṯ šə·qā·lîm
verses.literal: And if [the person is] from five to . . . twenty . . . years of age . . . then your valuation for the male shall be twenty shekels and for the female ten shekels

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם מִבֶּן־ חֹ֗דֶשׁ וְעַד֙ בֶּן־ חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים עֶרְכְּךָ֙ הַזָּכָ֔ר וְהָיָ֤ה חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה שְׁקָלִ֖ים כָּ֑סֶף וְלַנְּקֵבָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֔ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im mib·ben- ḥō·ḏeš wə·‘aḏ ben- ḥā·mêš šā·nîm ‘er·kə·ḵā haz·zā·ḵār wə·hā·yāh ḥă·miš·šāh šə·qā·lîm kā·sep̄ wə·lan·nə·qê·ḇāh ‘er·kə·ḵā šə·lō·šeṯ šə·qā·lîm kā·sep̄
verses.literal: Now if [the person is] - from one month to . . . five years of age then your valuation for the male shall be five shekels of silver and for the female - three shekels of silver

verses.original: וְ֠אִם מִבֶּן־ שִׁשִּׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה וָמַ֙עְלָה֙ אִם־ עֶרְכְּךָ֔ וְהָיָ֣ה חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר שָׁ֑קֶל זָכָ֔ר עֲשָׂרָ֥ה שְׁקָלִֽים׃ וְלַנְּקֵבָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wə·’im mib·ben- šiš·šîm šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh ’im- ‘er·kə·ḵā wə·hā·yāh ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār šā·qel zā·ḵār ‘ă·śā·rāh šə·qā·lîm wə·lan·nə·qê·ḇāh
verses.literal: And if [the person is] . . . sixty years of age or older . . . then your valuation shall be fifteen . . . shekels for the male and ten shekels for the female

verses.original: וְאִם־ הוּא֙ מָ֥ךְ מֵֽעֶרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְהֶֽעֱמִידוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֵ֔ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְהֶעֱרִ֥יךְ אֹת֖וֹ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃ס יַעֲרִיכֶ֖נּוּ עַל־ פִּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר הַנֹּדֵ֔ר תַּשִּׂיג֙ יַ֣ד
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- hū māḵ mê·‘er·ke·ḵā wə·he·‘ĕ·mî·ḏōw lip̄·nê hak·kō·hên hak·kō·hên wə·he·‘ĕ·rîḵ ’ō·ṯōw hak·kō·hên ya·‘ă·rî·ḵen·nū ‘al- pî ’ă·šer han·nō·ḏêr taś·śîḡ yaḏ
verses.literal: But if [the one making the vow] is too poor to pay the valuation he is to present [the person] before the priest [who] shall set the value - - - according to . . . what the one making the vow can afford . . .

verses.original: וְאִם־ מִמֶּ֛נָּה בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֧יבוּ קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהוָ֑ה כֹּל֩ מִמֶּ֛נּוּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֥ן לַיהוָ֖ה יִֽהְיֶה־ קֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- mim·men·nāh bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer yaq·rî·ḇū qār·bān Yah·weh kōl mim·men·nū ’ă·šer yit·tên Yah·weh yih·yeh- qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: If [he vows] an animal that may be brought as an offering to the LORD any such [animal] - given to the LORD shall be holy

verses.original: לֹ֣א יַחֲלִיפֶ֗נּוּ וְלֹֽא־ יָמִ֥יר אֹת֛וֹ ט֥וֹב בְּרָ֖ע אוֹ־ רַ֣ע בְּט֑וֹב וְאִם־ הָמֵ֨ר יָמִ֤יר בְּהֵמָה֙ בִּבְהֵמָ֔ה ה֥וּא וּתְמוּרָת֖וֹ יִֽהְיֶה־ וְהָֽיָה־ קֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lō ya·ḥă·lî·p̄en·nū wə·lō- yā·mîr ’ō·ṯōw ṭō·wḇ bə·rā‘ ’ōw- ra‘ bə·ṭō·wḇ wə·’im- hā·mêr yā·mîr bə·hê·māh biḇ·hê·māh hū ū·ṯə·mū·rā·ṯōw yih·yeh- wə·hā·yāh- qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: He must not replace it . . . or exchange it - either good for bad or bad for good But if he does substitute . . . one animal for another both that animal and its substitute . . . will be holy

verses.original: וְאִם֙ כָּל־ טְמֵאָ֔ה בְּהֵמָ֣ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא־ יַקְרִ֧יבוּ מִמֶּ֛נָּה קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהוָ֑ה הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה וְהֶֽעֱמִ֥יד אֶת־ לִפְנֵ֥י הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im kāl- ṭə·mê·’āh bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer lō- yaq·rî·ḇū mim·men·nāh qār·bān Yah·weh hab·bə·hê·māh wə·he·‘ĕ·mîḏ ’eṯ- lip̄·nê hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: But if the vow involves any of the unclean animals that may not be brought . . . as an offering to the LORD the animal must be presented - before the priest

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֹתָ֔הּ בֵּ֥ין וְהֶעֱרִ֤יךְ ט֖וֹב וּבֵ֣ין רָ֑ע הַכֹּהֵ֖ן כְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ כֵּ֥ן יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên ’ō·ṯāh bên wə·he·‘ĕ·rîḵ ṭō·wḇ ū·ḇên rā‘ hak·kō·hên kə·‘er·kə·ḵā kên yih·yeh
verses.literal: The priest - - shall set its value whether high . . . or low as the priest values it the price will be set

verses.original: וְאִם־ גָּאֹ֖ל יִגְאָלֶ֑נָּה וְיָסַ֥ף חֲמִישִׁת֖וֹ עַל־ עֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- gā·’ōl yiḡ·’ā·len·nāh wə·yā·sap̄ ḥă·mî·ši·ṯōw ‘al- ‘er·ke·ḵā
verses.literal: If, however, [the owner] decides to redeem [the animal] . . . he must add a fifth to its value

verses.original: כִּֽי־ וְאִ֗ישׁ יַקְדִּ֨שׁ אֶת־ בֵּית֥וֹ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהֶעֱרִיכוֹ֙ בֵּ֥ין ט֖וֹב וּבֵ֣ין רָ֑ע יָקֽוּם׃ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הַכֹּהֵ֖ן כֵּ֥ן יַעֲרִ֥יךְ אֹת֛וֹ
verses.transliteration: kî- wə·’îš yaq·diš ’eṯ- bê·ṯōw qō·ḏeš Yah·weh hak·kō·hên wə·he·‘ĕ·rî·ḵōw bên ṭō·wḇ ū·ḇên rā‘ yā·qūm ka·’ă·šer hak·kō·hên kên ya·‘ă·rîḵ ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Now if a man consecrates - his house as holy to the LORD then the priest shall value it either as good or bad The price will stand just as the priest . . . values it

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם־ הַמַּקְדִּ֔ישׁ בֵּית֑וֹ יִגְאַ֖ל אֶת־ וְ֠יָסַף חֲמִישִׁ֧ית עָלָ֖יו עֶרְכְּךָ֛ כֶּֽסֶף־ וְהָ֥יָה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ham·maq·dîš bê·ṯōw yiḡ·’al ’eṯ- wə·yā·sap̄ ḥă·mî·šîṯ ‘ā·lāw ‘er·kə·ḵā ke·sep̄- wə·hā·yāh lōw
verses.literal: But if he who consecrated his house redeems it he must add a fifth to the assessed value and it will belong to him

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם׀ אִישׁ֙ יַקְדִּ֥ישׁ לַֽיהוָ֔ה מִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֗וֹ עֶרְכְּךָ֖ וְהָיָ֥ה לְפִ֣י זַרְע֑וֹ בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שֶׁ֥קֶל כָּֽסֶף׃ חֹ֣מֶר שְׂעֹרִ֔ים זֶ֚רַע
verses.transliteration: wə·’im ’îš yaq·dîš Yah·weh miś·śə·ḏêh ’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯōw ‘er·kə·ḵā wə·hā·yāh lə·p̄î zar·‘ōw ba·ḥă·miš·šîm še·qel kā·sep̄ ḥō·mer śə·‘ō·rîm ze·ra‘
verses.literal: If a man consecrates to the LORD a parcel of his land then your valuation shall be proportional to the seed required for it fifty shekels of silver for every homer of barley seed

verses.original: אִם־ יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵ֑הוּ מִשְּׁנַ֥ת הַיֹּבֵ֖ל יָקֽוּם׃ כְּעֶרְכְּךָ֖
verses.transliteration: ’im- yaq·dîš śā·ḏê·hū miš·šə·naṯ hay·yō·ḇêl yā·qūm kə·‘er·kə·ḵā
verses.literal: If he consecrates his field during the Year of Jubilee the price will stand according to your valuation

verses.original: וְאִם־ יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵהוּ֒ אַחַ֣ר הַיֹּבֵל֮ הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ וְחִשַּׁב־ ל֨וֹ הַכֶּ֗סֶף עַל־ פִּ֤י הַשָּׁנִים֙ הַנּ֣וֹתָרֹ֔ת עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל מֵֽעֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃ וְנִגְרַ֖ע
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- yaq·dîš śā·ḏê·hū ’a·ḥar hay·yō·ḇêl hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- wə·ḥiš·šaḇ- lōw hak·ke·sep̄ ‘al- pî haš·šā·nîm han·nō·w·ṯā·rōṯ ‘aḏ šə·naṯ hay·yō·ḇêl mê·‘er·ke·ḵā wə·niḡ·ra‘
verses.literal: But if he consecrates his field after the Jubilee the priest - is to calculate the price in proportion to . . . the years left until the next Year of Jubilee so that your valuation will be reduced

verses.original: וְאִם־ הַמַּקְדִּ֖ישׁ אֹת֑וֹ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה גָּאֹ֤ל יִגְאַל֙ אֶת־ וְ֠יָסַף חֲמִשִׁ֧ית עָלָ֖יו עֶרְכְּךָ֛ כֶּֽסֶף־ וְקָ֥ם לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ham·maq·dîš ’ō·ṯōw haś·śā·ḏeh gā·’ōl yiḡ·’al ’eṯ- wə·yā·sap̄ ḥă·mi·šîṯ ‘ā·lāw ‘er·kə·ḵā ke·sep̄- wə·qām lōw
verses.literal: And if the one who consecrated - the field decides to redeem it . . . - he must add a fifth to the assessed value and it shall belong to him

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֤א יִגְאַל֙ אֶת־ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וְאִם־ מָכַ֥ר אֶת־ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה אַחֵ֑ר לְאִ֣ישׁ לֹ֥א עֽוֹד׃ יִגָּאֵ֖ל
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō yiḡ·’al ’eṯ- haś·śā·ḏeh wə·’im- mā·ḵar ’eṯ- haś·śā·ḏeh ’a·ḥêr lə·’îš lō ‘ō·wḏ yig·gā·’êl
verses.literal: If, however he does not redeem - the field or if he has sold - it to another man it may no longer be redeemed

verses.original: הַשָּׂדֶ֜ה בְּצֵאת֣וֹ בַיֹּבֵ֗ל וְהָיָ֨ה קֹ֛דֶשׁ כִּשְׂדֵ֣ה הַחֵ֑רֶם לַֽיהוָ֖ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃ לַכֹּהֵ֖ן
verses.transliteration: haś·śā·ḏeh bə·ṣê·ṯōw ḇay·yō·ḇêl wə·hā·yāh qō·ḏeš kiś·ḏêh ha·ḥê·rem Yah·weh tih·yeh ’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯōw lak·kō·hên
verses.literal: When the field is released in the Jubilee it will become holy like a field devoted to the LORD it becomes the property of the priests

verses.original: וְאִם֙ אֶת־ יַקְדִּ֖ישׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃ שְׂדֵ֣ה מִקְנָת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֕ר לֹ֖א מִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֑וֹ
verses.transliteration: wə·’im ’eṯ- yaq·dîš Yah·weh śə·ḏêh miq·nā·ṯōw ’ă·šer lō miś·śə·ḏêh ’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Now if [a man] consecrates to the LORD a field he has purchased which is not a part of his own property

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֵ֚ת וְחִשַּׁב־ ל֣וֹ מִכְסַ֣ת הָֽעֶרְכְּךָ֔ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְנָתַ֤ן אֶת־ הָעֶרְכְּךָ֙ הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên ’êṯ wə·ḥiš·šaḇ- lōw miḵ·saṯ hā·‘er·kə·ḵā ‘aḏ šə·naṯ hay·yō·ḇêl wə·nā·ṯan ’eṯ- hā·‘er·kə·ḵā ha·hū bay·yō·wm qō·ḏeš Yah·weh
verses.literal: then the priest - shall calculate for him the value . . . up to the Year of Jubilee and [the man] shall pay - the assessed value on that day as a sacred offering to the LORD

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֤ת הַיּוֹבֵל֙ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה יָשׁ֣וּב לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר קָנָ֖הוּ מֵאִתּ֑וֹ לַאֲשֶׁר־ ל֖וֹ אֲחֻזַּ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ hay·yō·w·ḇêl haś·śā·ḏeh yā·šūḇ la·’ă·šer qā·nā·hū mê·’it·tōw la·’ă·šer- lōw ’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to the one from whom it was bought . . . - - the original owner of the land

verses.original: וְכָל־ עֶרְכְּךָ֔ יִהְיֶ֖ה הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה הַשָּֽׁקֶל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ‘er·kə·ḵā yih·yeh haq·qō·ḏeš bə·še·qel ‘eś·rîm gê·rāh yih·yeh haš·šā·qel
verses.literal: Every valuation will be according to the sanctuary shekel twenty gerahs . . . to the shekel

verses.original: אַךְ־ לֹֽא־ אִ֖ישׁ אֹת֑וֹ יַקְדִּ֥ישׁ בְּכ֞וֹר בִּבְהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ יְבֻכַּ֤ר לַֽיהוָה֙ אִם־ שׁ֣וֹר אִם־ שֶׂ֔ה הֽוּא׃ לַֽיהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- lō- ’îš ’ō·ṯōw yaq·dîš bə·ḵō·wr biḇ·hê·māh ’ă·šer- yə·ḇuk·kar Yah·weh ’im- šō·wr ’im- śeh hū Yah·weh
verses.literal: But no one - may consecrate a firstborn of the livestock because a firstborn belongs to the LORD Whether [it is] an ox or a sheep it [is] the LORD’s

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם הַטְּמֵאָה֙ בַּבְּהֵמָ֤ה וּפָדָ֣ה בְעֶרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְיָסַ֥ף חֲמִשִׁת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְאִם־ לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל וְנִמְכַּ֥ר בְּעֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im haṭ·ṭə·mê·’āh bab·bə·hê·māh ū·p̄ā·ḏāh ḇə·‘er·ke·ḵā wə·yā·sap̄ ḥă·mi·ši·ṯōw ‘ā·lāw wə·’im- lō yig·gā·’êl wə·nim·kar bə·‘er·ke·ḵā
verses.literal: But if [it is] among the unclean animals then he may redeem it according to your valuation and add a fifth of its value If it is not redeemed then it shall be sold according to your valuation

verses.original: אַךְ־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִ֨ישׁ חֵ֡רֶם יַחֲרִם֩ לַֽיהוָ֜ה מִכָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֗וֹ מֵאָדָ֤ם וּבְהֵמָה֙ וּמִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֔וֹ לֹ֥א יִמָּכֵ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יִגָּאֵ֑ל כָּל־ חֵ֕רֶם קֹֽדֶשׁ־ קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- kāl- ’ă·šer ’îš ḥê·rem ya·ḥă·rim Yah·weh mik·kāl ’ă·šer- lōw mê·’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh ū·miś·śə·ḏêh ’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯōw lō yim·mā·ḵêr wə·lō yig·gā·’êl kāl- ḥê·rem qō·ḏeš- qā·ḏā·šîm hū Yah·weh
verses.literal: - Nothing that a man sets apart . . . to the LORD from all he owns - whether a man an animal or his inherited land . . . - can be sold . . . or redeemed everything so devoted [is] most holy . . . to the LORD

verses.original: כָּל־ חֵ֗רֶם אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹ֣א הָאָדָ֖ם יָחֳרַ֛ם מִן־ יִפָּדֶ֑ה מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ḥê·rem ’ă·šer lō hā·’ā·ḏām yā·ḥo·ram min- yip·pā·ḏeh mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: No . . . - - person set apart for destruction . . . may be ransomed he must surely be put to death . . .

verses.original: וְכָל־ מַעְשַׂ֨ר הָאָ֜רֶץ מִזֶּ֤רַע הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ מִפְּרִ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ לַיהוָ֖ה ה֑וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ma‘·śar hā·’ā·reṣ miz·ze·ra‘ hā·’ā·reṣ mip·pə·rî hā·‘êṣ Yah·weh hū qō·ḏeš Yah·weh
verses.literal: Thus any tithe from the land [whether] from the seed of the land or the fruit of the trees belongs to the LORD it is holy to the LORD

verses.original: וְאִם־ אִ֖ישׁ גָּאֹ֥ל יִגְאַ֛ל מִמַּֽעַשְׂר֑וֹ יֹסֵ֥ף חֲמִשִׁית֖וֹ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’îš gā·’ōl yiḡ·’al mim·ma·‘aś·rōw yō·sêp̄ ḥă·mi·šî·ṯōw ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: If a man wishes to redeem part of his tithe he must add a fifth to its value

verses.original: וְכָל־ מַעְשַׂ֤ר בָּקָר֙ וָצֹ֔אן כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲבֹ֖ר תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑בֶט הָֽעֲשִׂירִ֕י יִֽהְיֶה־ קֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ma‘·śar bā·qār wā·ṣōn kōl ’ă·šer- ya·‘ă·ḇōr ta·ḥaṯ haš·šā·ḇeṭ hā·‘ă·śî·rî yih·yeh- qō·ḏeš Yah·weh
verses.literal: Every tenth animal from the herd or flock . . . that passes under the shepherd’s rod . . . will be holy to the LORD

verses.original: לֹ֧א יְבַקֵּ֛ר ט֥וֹב בֵּֽין־ לָרַ֖ע וְלֹ֣א יְמִירֶ֑נּוּ וְאִם־ הָמֵ֣ר יְמִירֶ֔נּוּ ה֧וּא וּתְמוּרָת֛וֹ יִֽהְיֶה־ וְהָֽיָה־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lō yə·ḇaq·qêr ṭō·wḇ bên- lā·ra‘ wə·lō yə·mî·ren·nū wə·’im- hā·mêr yə·mî·ren·nū hū ū·ṯə·mū·rā·ṯōw yih·yeh- wə·hā·yāh- qō·ḏeš lō yig·gā·’êl
verses.literal: He must not inspect whether it is good or bad and he shall not make any substitution But if he does make a substitution . . . both the animal and its substitute . . . shall become holy they cannot be redeemed

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַמִּצְוֺ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ צִוָּ֧ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּהַ֖ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ham·miṣ·wōṯ ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’eṯ- ṣiw·wāh mō·šeh ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bə·har sî·nāy
verses.literal: These are the commandments that the LORD - gave to Moses for the Israelites . . . on Mount Sinai
